A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PointMapPolicy work. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable matching despite appendix deletions and repagination.

before.justification: v2 reports original RoboCasa and CALVIN evaluations, six real-world manipulation experiments, ablations, and activation-map analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains the original simulation and real-world results, ablations, and appendix activation-map analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same structured point maps, RGB fusion, xLSTM backbone, diffusion objective, and four-step DDIM inference. Deleted appendix characterizations do not establish an altered method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 16 RoboCasa tasks, CALVIN ABC-to-D setting, and six real-world tasks. Deleting Appendix A.3 does not remove coverage; the CALVIN benchmark and split remain documented in A.2.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 and Figure 5 retain identical comparator sets. However, v2's Appendix A.2 additionally lists HULC, LAD, Distill-D, and MT-ACT and claims superiority over HULC and Distill-D, although Table 2 contains none of them. v3 deletes this text, leaving uncertain whether any actual evaluated comparison was removed.

E3.justification: The retained splits, metrics, training budgets, checkpoint selection, evaluation sizes, and Table 6 settings are unchanged. Removing Appendix A.3 reduces documentation without specifying a different experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The controlled point-cloud encoder comparison, fusion and visual-encoder ablations, and Grad-CAM++ analyses remain unchanged in Sections 4.2–4.3 and Appendix D, including Figures 5–6 and 8–10.

E5.justification: Deleting Appendix A.3 removes the explicit statement that CALVIN results average over three random seeds. v3 retains evaluation 'per seed' without specifying the count. RoboCasa's three-seed disclosure and uncertainty values remain unchanged; fewer actual runs are not established.

E6.justification: All numerical tables, plots, and activation maps are unchanged, including PMP's CALVIN score of 4.01. v3 nevertheless removes Appendix A.2's qualitative assertion that PMP surpasses HULC and Distill-D, which was not substantiated by corresponding Table 2 entries.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, point-map definition, and diffusion and projection equations remain identical. Neither version adds or removes theoretical propositions, proofs, or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about point-map novelty, multimodal perception, benchmark performance, and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: v3 deletes A.2's interpretation of CALVIN success as demonstrating grounded spatial-goal representations without pretraining or frozen vision-language encoders. This removes an overbroad characterization inconsistent with Section 3's pretrained encoders. Main-text interpretations and Section 6's limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Deleting A.3 removes the explicit CALVIN proprioceptive-input description and seven-dimensional end-effector action specification. Table 6 hyperparameters, Appendix E compute details, and project and analysis-code links remain unchanged. This is reduced disclosure, not demonstrated implementation change.

R1.justification: Appendix A.2 removes discussion and associated citations for HULC, LAD, Distill-D, and MT-ACT, modestly narrowing the prior-work discussion. Section 2's substantive research positioning remains unchanged; duplicate-reference consolidation does not represent removal of distinct research.

P1.justification: v3 rewrites acknowledgments, revises bibliographic metadata, trims appendix baseline descriptions, and deletes the A.2 results paragraph and A.3 subsection. The main scientific narrative is unchanged apart from citation numbering.

P2.justification: All figures and tables retain their content and design. Appendix reflow places Table 5 amid the CALVIN baseline-list continuation and Table 6 below real-world task descriptions, while splitting the activation-map discussion across pages.

improvement.justification: v3 improves internal consistency by consolidating citations and removing unsupported comparator prose and the contradictory blanket claim of no pretraining. However, it also removes the only explicit CALVIN seed count and action/observation specification. The scientific evidence remains unchanged, and the PDFs do not explain whether those deleted disclosures were erroneous. These competing effects on clarity and reproducibility prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
